name: tsa_createInvite
description: Creates a TSA.WorkerInvite with a 64-character hex token from CRYPT_GEN_RANDOM(32), expiring 48 hours from now, and returns the invite including the token for the registration QR code URL. Called from the TSA Eats admin dashboard (admin cookie checked by the Next.js middleware, not by the SP). Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'createInvite' to [TSA].[tsa_createInvite]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: TSA officer first name. No default; not validated for blank.

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: TSA officer last name. No default; not validated for blank.

parameters.name: createdByAdmin
parameters.description: Admin username creating the invite. No default.

rowsets.name: Invite
rowsets.description: Success: one row describing the new invite.

columns.name: token
columns.description: 64-char uppercase hex token for the QR code URL.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On any error (CATCH, line 37) instead of the Invite rowset. A different shape from the success rowset.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Fixed user-facing text, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block (raw SQL Server text).

codeSmells.detail: @firstName, @lastName, @createdByAdmin (lines 2-4) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the body runs: no log row, and the TsaApi shim returns a generic 500.
The CATCH (lines 36-38) returns the error envelope but writes nothing to HC.ErrorLog or any TSA log table, so failures are only visible in Azure Function logs as a 400 warning.

codeSmells.issue: Success and error rowsets differ in shape
codeSmells.detail: Success returns {id, token, firstName, lastName, expiresAt}; the CATCH returns {Success, ErrorMessage}. Only the shim's Success = 0 detection tells them apart.

codeSmells.issue: Width-matched NVARCHAR(100) parameters on user text
codeSmells.detail: @firstName/@lastName are NVARCHAR(100), the column width, with no LEN() check: longer input is silently truncated at the parameter.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
